author: Camemes
body:
Tell us what you are allergic to or if you are one of the lucky ones and have no allergies!

Personally, I am allergic to grass (yes, grass) Weeds, cat and dog saliva and pollen. If I come into contact with these things, I get itchy when I tough grass as well as contract sinus, this is the same with my other allergies!

Well enough about me, what are your allergies?

replies.body:
I haven't gotten a test done yet, but I know I'm allergic to:

- Cats
- Dogs (none of mine shed, so I'm usually alright at home)
- Certain types of trees (I know, it's bizarre.. unsure on the specific types that trigger my allergies, but the bark of certain types of trees gives me rashes :c)
- Dust
- Kiwi
- Various other things that I can't think of at the top of my head, but that I know I have.
